name: Feature request

title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?
A clear description of the developer workflow or pain point this addresses.

## Proposed solution
What would you like to see added or changed? If this is a new tool, describe:
- What input it takes
- What output it produces
- Any options/settings it needs

## Does it fit the offline-first philosophy?
x-DevPocket ships zero network dependencies — every tool runs entirely on-device. Please confirm this feature doesn't require a backend, API key, or internet connection. If it inherently needs one (e.g. "look up the latest npm package version"), explain the trade-off you have in mind.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you've thought about.

## Additional context
Mockups, links, or examples from other tools are welcome.
